subject: Branch VPN tunnels dropping every 15 minutes
body:
Dear Infrastructure Support,

Since Friday evening the site-to-site VPN tunnels between our head office and 12 branches have been dropping roughly every 15 minutes. Core banking sessions at the branches are cut off each time, which forces tellers to log in again and in some cases lose half-entered transactions. The firewall is a FortiLine 90F running 7.2.4, and the logs show 'IKE phase 2 negotiation failed' and 'DPD timeout' at each drop. We have confirmed the ISP links show no packet loss, and we already rebooted the firewall and re-created the phase 2 selectors on two of the tunnels. Nothing changed in our configuration before the issue began, according to our change log. This is affecting live branch operations, so we need an engineer on a call as early as possible.

Suresh Narayanan
Metro Cooperative Bank, IT Infrastructure
